config.selection_evaluation: The runner reloads the original float64 arrays and reevaluates the saved last-rounded plan with its separate Torch FP64 validator. The final report checks these endpoint objectives and the selected winner using NumPy/POT; selection itself does not use a separate numerical library.
config.theory_scope: Published SMD step and MSBPG coupled step/momentum schedules are unchanged. Only theorem-admissible prefactors are tuned; finite 1e-7 proximal tolerances do not assert an inexact outer theorem.
config.timing_scope: Up to four one-thread processes overlap. Runtime values describe these executions and are not used for method speed rankings.
